what_changes: The same 5.0% loss fault, but an oracle immediately commits the localized reroute, so worker 2's traffic leaves the lossy egress; the measured retention is the pure cost of displacing that traffic onto Fabric B. Worker 2's Fabric B access is additionally capped to 50 Mbit before any round runs, so the surviving plane has no free headroom and the switch cost becomes visible; the matched baseline shares the same cap.
expected: Exactly three worker-2 slots move, correctness holds, and the post-recovery retention for this loss level is reported; no retention bound is asserted.
